groups.criterion_quote: All areas of the establishment are operating and/or maintained in a condition that ensures prescribed goods are not, or not likely to be infested by pests or be contaminated.

source_evidence.quote: All areas of the establishment are operating and/or maintained in a condition that ensures prescribed goods are not, or not likely to be infested by pests or be contaminated.
that ensures that prescribed plants and plant products at the establishment are not, or not likely to be, infested by pests or contaminated.
the establishment must be kept in a clean and hygienic condition appropriate for the export operations carried out at the establishment and the kind of plants or plant products;
pests and contaminants at the establishment must be controlled in a manner that is appropriate for the export operations and the kind of prescribed plants or plant products;

groups.reason: The CP criterion is a single broad requirement that the establishment be maintained in a condition preventing pest infestation or contamination. The three rules provisions all operationalise this same requirement: 4-7A(1)(b) states the general outcome, while 4-7A(2)(a) and (b) provide specific means (cleanliness and pest control) that support that outcome. They do not represent independent cumulative requirements of the CP, but rather different legal expressions of the same benchmark condition.

rationale_summary: All three grounded norms support the same CP criterion by providing the general requirement and its specific operationalisations. No explicit connector in the CP or rules establishes that they must be satisfied cumulatively or alternatively; therefore, they are grouped as SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION.
